about: Dengo Studios is an independent game development team driven by a passion for crafting unique and polished experiences. Founded just one year ago, our close-knit team of four developers has already brought two distinct titles from concept to launch.

We believe in the power of small teams to deliver focused, creative, and memorable games. With a productive first year and two projects already in our portfolio, we are focused on building worlds and stories that resonate with players.
